items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I'm a little guy by the name of George Washington, used to play trombone with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. He'd never catch any fool around with them high notes. Oh, he stayed right in there. Trying to make some hominies too. I'm a little guy by the name of George Washington, used to play trombone with him.
I've heard of him, yeah. I never knew him.
